title: Madhya-khanda, part 3 (portion 26)
html:
The mango tree — a lesson on maya and on offering all acts to Krishna; instruction to Mukunda on worshipping two-armed Krishna; Murari begs for mercy; Srivasa and Sri Rama; the blaspheming brahmana and the Lord's bath; the section "The Truth about Advaita": the Lord with Advaita Acharya

Raga varadi; refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — Gora, Shachi's darling!"

আর-দিনে আর কথা শুন অদ্ভুত ।
নিতুই নূতন প্রকাশয়ে শচীসুত ॥ ২৫ ॥

āra-dine āra kathā śuna adbhuta |
nitui nūtana prakāśaẏe śacīsuta || 25 ||

ara-dine — on another day; ara katha — another story; shuna adbhuta — hear, wonderful; nitui nutana — ever new; prakashaye shachisuta — the son of Shachi reveals

25Hear yet another wonderful story of another day:
every day the son of Shachi reveals something new.

অতি অপরূপ কথা লোকে অবিদিত ।
অধমজনের মনে না হয় প্রতীত ॥ ২৬ ॥

ati aparūpa kathā loke abidita |
adhamajanera mane nā haẏa pratīta || 26 ||

ati aparupa katha — a most unusual story; loke avidita — unknown to people; adhama-janera mane — in the hearts of low people; na haya pratita — no faith arises

26This story is most unusual, unknown to people;
in the hearts of low people faith in it does not arise.

কেবল নিগূঢ় প্রকাশয়ে ঠাকুরাল ।
নিজজনে কহে দেখ মিছা এ সংসার ॥ ২৭ ॥

kebala nigūṛha prakāśaẏe ṭhākurāla |
nijajane kahe dekha michā e saṃsāra || 27 ||

kevala nigudha — only in secret; prakashaye thakurala — reveals His lordship; nija-jane kahe — says to His own; dekha — see; michha e samsara — this world is illusory

27Only in secret does He reveal His lordship;
to His own He says: "See: this world is illusory"1.

ইহা বলি' আন-পরসঙ্গে কহে আন ।
পাসরিল সবলোক লয় হরিনাম ॥ ২৮ ॥

ihā bali' āna-parasaṅge kahe āna |
pāsarila sabaloka laẏa harināma || 28 ||

iha bali — saying this; ana-parasange — on another subject; kahe ana — speaks of something else; pasarila saba-loka — all forgot; laya hari-nama — repeat the name of Hari

28Saying this, He spoke of something else;
all forgot [about it] and repeat the name of Hari.

নিজ-নাম-সংকীর্তনে মাতল অন্তর ।
ভূমিতে লুটাঞা কান্দে প্রেম-পরবল ॥ ২৯ ॥

nija-nāma-saṃkīrtane mātala antara |
bhūmite luṭāñā kānde prema-parabala || 29 ||

nija-nama-sankirtane — by the sankirtana of His own name; matala antara — the heart became intoxicated; bhumite lutana kande — rolling on the ground He weeps; prema-parabala — overpowered by prema

29[His] heart became intoxicated with the sankirtana of His own name;
overpowered by prema, He rolls on the ground and weeps.

আচম্বিতে উঠি' কহে দিয়া করতালি ।
নিজজনে প্রকাশয়ে নিজ-ঠাকুরালি ॥ ৩০ ॥

ācambite uṭhi' kahe diẏā karatāli |
nijajane prakāśaẏe nija-ṭhākurāli || 30 ||

achambite uthi — suddenly rising; kahe diya karatali — speaks, clapping His hands; nija-jane — to His own; prakashaye nija-thakurali — reveals His own lordship

30Suddenly He rises and speaks, clapping His hands —
He reveals His lordship to His own:

দেখ দেখ আম্রবীজ আরোপিল আমি ।
আমার অর্জিত তরু হইবে আপনি ॥ ৩১ ॥

dekha dekha āmrabīja āropila āmi |
āmāra arjita taru haibe āpani || 31 ||

dekha dekha — look, look; amra-bija aropila ami — I have planted a mango stone; amara arjita taru — the tree I have raised; haibe apani — will grow by itself

31"Look, look: I have planted a mango stone —
the tree I have raised will grow by itself!"

তখনে কহয়ে সব জনে আচম্বিত ।
এখনি রোপিল বীজ ভেল অঙ্কুরিত ॥ ৩২ ॥

takhane kahaẏe saba jane ācambita |
ekhani ropila bīja bhela aṅkurita || 32 ||

takhane — then; kahaye saba jane — all say; achambita — suddenly; ekhani ropila bija — He has just planted the stone; bhela ankurita — it has sprouted

32Then all suddenly say:
"He has only just planted the stone — and it has sprouted already!"

দেখিতে দেখিতে ভেল তরু মঞ্জরিত ।
হইল উত্তম শাখা তরু মুকুলিত ॥ ৩৩ ॥

dekhite dekhite bhela taru mañjarita |
haila uttama śākhā taru mukulita || 33 ||

dekhite dekhite — before their eyes; bhela taru manjarita — the tree put out shoots; haila uttama shakha — fine branches grew; taru mukulita — the tree budded

33Before their eyes the tree put out shoots,
fine branches grew, the tree was covered with buds.

দেখ দেখ সব-লোক অপরূপ আর ।
মুকুলিত হৈল হের তরুটা আমার ॥ ৩৪ ॥

dekha dekha saba-loka aparūpa āra |
mukulita haila hera taruṭā āmāra || 34 ||

dekha dekha saba-loka — look, look, all people; aparupa ara — another wonder; mukulita haila — has budded; hera — see; taruta amara — My little tree

34"Look, look, all you people — another wonder:
see, My little tree is covered with buds!"

তখনি হইল ফল পাকিল সেকালে ।
আঙ্গুলি হেলাঞা প্রভু দেখায় সভারে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

takhani haila phala pākila sekāle |
āṅguli helāñā prabhu dekhāẏa sabhāre || 35 ||

takhani haila phala — at once fruits appeared; pakila se-kale — ripened at that moment; anguli helana — pointing with the finger; prabhu dekhaya sabhare — the Lord shows all

35At once fruits appeared and at that very moment ripened;
pointing with His finger, the Lord shows them to all.

পাড়িয়া আনিল ফল দেখে সব লোকে ।
নিবেদন করি' দিল ঈশ্বর-সম্মুখে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

pāṛiẏā ānila phala dekhe saba loke |
nibedana kari' dila īśbara-sammukhe || 36 ||

padiya anila phala — they plucked and brought the fruits; dekhe saba loke — all the people see; nivedana kari — making an offering; dila ishvara-sammukhe — placed before the Ishvara

36They plucked the fruits and brought them — all the people see it —
and, making an offering, placed them before the Ishvara.

তিলেকে সকল সেই না দেখিয়ে কিছু ।
ফলমাত্র আছে গাছ মিছা হৈল পাছু ॥ ৩৭ ॥

tileke sakala sei nā dekhiẏe kichu |
phalamātra āche gācha michā haila pāchu || 37 ||

tileke — in a moment; sakala sei — all that; na dekhiye kichhu — nothing is seen; phala-matra achhe — only the fruits remain; gachha michha haila pachhu — the tree afterwards proved illusory

37In a moment none of it is to be seen:
only the fruits remain, and the tree has proved illusory.

ঐছে মায়া দেখাইল কহে সর্বলোকে ।
ইহা জানি' না মরিহ এ সংসার-শোকে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

aiche māẏā dekhāila kahe sarbaloke |
ihā jāni' nā mariha e saṃsāra-śoke || 38 ||

aichhe maya dekhaila — such maya He showed; kahe sarva-loke — He tells all people; iha jani — knowing this; na mariha — do not die; e samsara-shoke — of the grief of this world

38Such maya He showed, and He tells all the people:
"Knowing this, do not die of the grief of this world.

মোর মায়াবলে সৃষ্টি সকল সংসার ।
না বুঝি' সকল লোক বোলে আপনার ॥ ৩৯ ॥

mora māẏābale sṛṣṭi sakala saṃsāra |
nā bujhi' sakala loka bole āpanāra || 39 ||

mora maya-bale — by the power of My maya; srishti sakala samsara — the whole world is created; na bujhi — not understanding; sakala loka — all people; bole apanara — call it their own

39By the power of My maya the whole world is created;
not understanding this, all people call it their own.

মোর মায়া-দড়ি কেবা ছিঁড়িবারে পারে ।
সবে এক পথ আছে মায়া জিনিবারে ॥ ৪০ ॥

mora māẏā-daṛi kebā chiṁṛibāre pāre |
sabe eka patha āche māẏā jinibāre || 40 ||

mora maya-dadi — the rope of My maya; keba chhindibare pare — who can tear; sabe eka patha achhe — there is but one way; maya jinibare — to conquer maya

40Who can tear the rope of My maya?
There is only one way to conquer maya2:

যত যত দেহ-ধর্ম-কর্ম করে লোকে ।
সর্বকর্ম আরোপণ করে যদি মোকে ॥ ৪১ ॥

yata yata deha-dharma-karma kare loke |
sarbakarma āropaṇa kare yadi moke || 41 ||

yata yata — whatever; deha-dharma-karma — acts as duties of the body; kare loke — people perform; sarva-karma aropana kare — dedicate all acts; yadi moke — if to Me

41if all the acts that people perform as duties of the body,
all their acts, people dedicate to Me,

তবে দেহ-সমর্পণ কৃষ্ণপদে হয় ।
কর্মাকর্ম-শুভাশুভ-বন্ধ নাহি হয় ॥ ৪২ ॥

tabe deha-samarpaṇa kṛṣṇapade haẏa |
karmākarma-śubhāśubha-bandha nāhi haẏa || 42 ||

tabe — then; deha-samarpana krishna-pade haya — the body is given to Krishna's feet; karmakarma-shubhashubha-bandha — the bondage of action and inaction, good and evil; nahi haya — there is not

42then the body is given to Krishna's feet,
and there is no more bondage of action or inaction, of good or evil.

এ ভক্তি পরম তত্ত্ব সমর্পণ গণি ।
সমর্পিতে কৃষ্ণে ভেদ না রহে আপনি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

e bhakti parama tattba samarpaṇa gaṇi |
samarpite kṛṣṇe bheda nā rahe āpani || 43 ||

e bhakti — this bhakti; parama tattva — the highest truth; samarpana gani — reckon as dedication; samarpite krishne — on giving to Krishna; bheda na rahe apani — separateness of itself does not remain

43This bhakti is the highest truth: reckon it as dedication;
when one gives [all] to Krishna, separateness of itself does not remain3.

সব সমর্পিলে কৃষ্ণ পাই সর্বথায় ।
সকল পুরাণে গীতা ভাগবতে গায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

saba samarpile kṛṣṇa pāi sarbathāẏa |
sakala purāṇe gītā bhāgabate gāẏa || 44 ||

saba samarpile — having dedicated all; krishna pai sarvathaya — one surely obtains Krishna; sakala purane — in all the Puranas; gita bhagavate gaya — the Gita and the Bhagavata sing

44Having dedicated all, one surely attains Krishna —
so sing all the Puranas, the Gita and the Bhagavata.

নহে বা সকল এই হয় অনর্থক ।
ঈশ্বরে অর্পিলে সব সংসার সার্থক ॥ ৪৫ ॥

nahe bā sakala ei haẏa anarthaka |
īśbare arpile saba saṃsāra sārthaka || 45 ||

nahe ba — otherwise; sakala ei haya anarthaka — all this is fruitless; ishvare arpile saba — if all is offered to the Ishvara; samsara sarthaka — worldly life becomes meaningful

45Otherwise all this is fruitless;
if one dedicates everything to the Ishvara, life in the world becomes meaningful"4.

হেন অদ্ভুত গোরাচাঁদের প্রকাশ ।
শুনি' আনন্দিত কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৬ ॥

hena adbhuta gorācāṁdera prakāśa |
śuni' ānandita kahe e locanadāsa || 46 ||

hena adbhuta — such a wondrous; gorachandera prakasha — manifestation of Gorachand; shuni — hearing; anandita kahe — joyfully says; e lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa

46Such is the wondrous manifestation of Gorachand.
Hearing of it, Lochana Dasa speaks in joy.

Raga shri; refrain: "O-ki ho-re, Gauranga, jaya, jaya!"

হেনই সময়ে বৈদ্য মুকুন্দ দেখিয়া ।
কহিলেন মহাপ্রভু মুচকি হাসিয়া ॥ ৪৭ ॥

henai samaẏe baidya mukunda dekhiẏā |
kahilena mahāprabhu mucaki hāsiẏā || 47 ||

henai samaye — at that time; vaidya mukunda dekhiya — seeing the vaidya Mukunda; kahilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; muchaki hasiya — with a slight smile

47At that time, seeing the vaidya Mukunda,
Mahaprabhu spoke with a slight smile:

তুমি নাকি ব্রহ্মবিদ্যা মান ইহা শুনি ।
ভাল ত মুকুন্দদত্ত তোমারে বাখানি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

tumi nāki brahmabidyā māna ihā śuni |
bhāla ta mukundadatta tomāre bākhāni || 48 ||

tumi naki — you, they say; brahma-vidya mana — honour the knowledge of Brahman; iha shuni — so I hear; bhala ta — well then; mukunda-datta — Mukunda Datta; tomare bakhani — I praise you

48"You, they say, honour the knowledge of Brahman — so I have heard.
Well, Mukunda Datta, I praise you!"

ইহা বলি' এই শ্লোক পঢ়িল ঠাকুর ।
শুনিতে সভার হিয়া করে দুরদুর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

ihā bali' ei śloka paṛhila ṭhākura |
śunite sabhāra hiẏā kare duradura || 49 ||

iha bali — saying this; ei shloka padhila thakura — the Thakura recited this shloka; shunite — on hearing; sabhara hiya — everyone's heart; kare duradura — trembled

49Saying this, the Thakura recited this shloka;
hearing it, everyone's heart trembled.

Thus in the Padma-purana (quoted in Kavi-karnapura's Chaitanya-charitamrita, 6.36):

রমন্তে যোগিনোঽনন্তে সত্যানন্দে চিদাত্মনি ।
ইতি রামপদেনাসৌ পরং ব্রহ্মাভিধীয়তে ॥ ৫০ ॥

ramante yogino'nante satyānande cidātmani |
iti rāmapadenāsau paraṃ brahmābhidhīẏate || 50 ||

ramante yoginah — the yogis delight; anante — in the Infinite; satya-anande — in the Truth and Bliss; chit-atmani — in the One whose self is consciousness; iti — therefore; rama-padena — by the word "Rama"; asau param brahma — that Supreme Brahman; abhidhiyate — is called

50"The yogis delight in the Infinite — in the Truth, the Bliss, the One whose self is consciousness; therefore the Supreme Brahman is called by the word 'Rama'"5.

তবে পুনঃ ভগবান্ সেই গৌরহরি ।
বৈদ্যেরে কহিল কিছু অনুগ্রহ করি' ॥ ৫১ ॥

tabe punaḥ bhagabān sei gaurahari |
baidyere kahila kichu anugraha kari' || 51 ||

tabe punah — then again; bhagavan sei gaurahari — Bhagavan Gaurahari; vaidyere kahila kichhu — said something to the vaidya; anugraha kari — showing favour

51Then Bhagavan Gaurahari
again, showing favour, said to the vaidya:

চতুর্ভুজ ভজন তুমি বড় করি' মান ।
দ্বিভুজ ধেয়ানে তোর অলপ গেয়ান ॥ ৫২ ॥

caturbhuja bhajana tumi baṛa kari' māna |
dbibhuja dheẏāne tora alapa geẏāna || 52 ||

chaturbhuja bhajana — worship of the Four-armed; tumi bada kari mana — you hold in high regard; dvibhuja dheyane — in meditation on the Two-armed; tora alapa geyana — your knowledge is small

52"You think highly of worshipping the Four-armed,
but in meditation on the Two-armed your knowledge is small.

সকল সম্পদ চাহ আপনার হিত ।
দ্বিভুজ ভজহ কৃষ্ণে মজাইয়া চিত ॥ ৫৩ ॥

sakala sampada cāha āpanāra hita |
dbibhuja bhajaha kṛṣṇe majāiẏā cita || 53 ||

sakala sampada chaha — [if] you want all riches; apanara hita — your own good; dvibhuja bhajaha krishne — worship two-armed Krishna; majaiya chita — immersing the heart

53If you want all riches and your own good,
worship two-armed Krishna, immersing your heart in Him.

কৃষ্ণের প্রকাশ নারায়ণ শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
নারায়ণ হৈতে কৃষ্ণ হেন বাক্য নহে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

kṛṣṇera prakāśa nārāẏaṇa śāstre kahe |
nārāẏaṇa haite kṛṣṇa hena bākya nahe || 54 ||

krishnera prakasha narayana — Narayana is Krishna's manifestation; shastre kahe — the shastras say; narayana haite krishna — Krishna from Narayana; hena vakya nahe — there is no such statement

54Narayana is a manifestation of Krishna, say the shastras;
there is no word that Krishna comes from Narayana"6.

ঐছন করুণ-বাণী কহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শুনিঞা সাদরে বৈদ্য প্রণতকন্ধর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

aichana karuṇa-bāṇī kahe biśbambhara |
śuniñā sādare baidya praṇatakandhara || 55 ||

aichhana karuna-vani — such compassionate words; kahe vishvambhara — Vishvambhara speaks; shunina sadare — hearing respectfully; vaidya pranata-kandhara — the vaidya bowed his head

55Such compassionate words Vishvambhara speaks;
hearing them, the vaidya respectfully bowed his head:

সুরনদী-জলে স্নান করি' করোঁ কাম ।
বৈষ্ণব-চরণ-ধূলি প্রসাদ-প্রধান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

suranadī-jale snāna kari' karoṁ kāma |
baiṣṇaba-caraṇa-dhūli prasāda-pradhāna || 56 ||

suranadi-jale — in the waters of the heavenly river; snana kari — bathing; karon kama — [I did] as I wished; vaishnava-charana-dhuli — the dust of the Vaishnavas' feet; prasada-pradhana — the chief grace

56"I have bathed my fill in the waters of the heavenly river;
the dust of the Vaishnavas' feet is [for me] the highest grace.

তোর পাদপদ্ম মোর শিরে রহু ছত্র ।
দাস্য-অভিষেক কর এই চাহোঁ মাত্র ॥ ৫৭ ॥

tora pādapadma mora śire rahu chatra |
dāsya-abhiṣeka kara ei cāhoṁ mātra || 57 ||

tora pada-padma — Your lotus feet; mora shire rahu chhatra — let them be an umbrella on my head; dasya-abhisheka kara — perform my anointing as a servant; ei chahon matra — this alone I ask

57Let Your lotus feet be an umbrella over my head:
perform my anointing as a servant — that alone I ask.

আমি কি জানিয়ে প্রভু নিজ ভাল-মন্দ ।
নিরন্তর অন্তরে বাহিরে মদ-অন্ধ ॥ ৫৮ ॥

āmi ki jāniẏe prabhu nija bhāla-manda |
nirantara antare bāhire mada-andha || 58 ||

ami ki janiye — what do I know; prabhu — Lord; nija bhala-manda — of my own good and ill; nirantara — always; antare bahire — within and without; mada-andha — blinded by pride

58What do I know, Lord, of my own good and ill?
Always, within and without, I am blinded by pride.

নিজগুণে করুণা করহ প্রভু যবে ।
নিজদাস্য-প্রসাদ করহ মোরে তবে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

nijaguṇe karuṇā karaha prabhu yabe |
nijadāsya-prasāda karaha more tabe || 59 ||

nija-gune — by Your own goodness; karuna karaha prabhu yabe — when You, Lord, show mercy; nija-dasya-prasada — the grace of Your service; karaha more tabe — grant me then

59When by Your own goodness You show me mercy,
then grant me the grace of serving You.

তুমি সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর বিগ্রহ আনন্দ ।
সেই নন্দসুত তুমি অবতারকন্দ ॥ ৬০ ॥

tumi sarbeśbareśbara bigraha ānanda |
sei nandasuta tumi abatārakanda || 60 ||

tumi sarveshvareshvara — You are the Lord of the lords of all; vigraha ananda — the embodiment of bliss; sei nandasuta tumi — You are that son of Nanda; avatara-kanda — the root of the avataras

60You are the Lord of the lords of all, the embodiment of bliss;
You are that very son of Nanda, the root of the avataras."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অন্তর-সন্তোষে ।
পদ-অরবিন্দ তার মস্তকে পরশে ॥ ৬১ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu antara-santoṣe |
pada-arabinda tāra mastake paraśe || 61 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhu antara-santoshe — the Lord, pleased at heart; pada-aravinda — with His lotus foot; tara mastake parashe — touches his head

61Hearing these words, the Lord, pleased at heart,
touched his head with His lotus foot.

সর্বাঙ্গে পুলক ভেল সজল-লোচন ।
গদগদ-ভাষ বৈদ্য প্রেম-লক্ষণ ॥ ৬২ ॥

sarbāṅge pulaka bhela sajala-locana |
gadagada-bhāṣa baidya prema-lakṣaṇa || 62 ||

sarvange pulaka bhela — his whole body thrilled; sajala-lochana — eyes full of tears; gadgada-bhasha vaidya — the vaidya's speech faltering; prema-lakshana — signs of prema

62[Mukunda's] whole body thrilled, his eyes filled with tears,
the vaidya's speech faltered — signs of prema.

গদগদস্বরে স্তব করিল বিস্তর ।
জয় মহামহেশ্বর কারণের পর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

gadagadasbare staba karila bistara |
jaẏa mahāmaheśbara kāraṇera para || 63 ||

gadgada-svare — in a faltering voice; stava karila vistara — offered long praise; jaya maha-maheshvara — glory to the Great Maheshvara; karanera para — beyond all causes

63In a faltering voice he offered long praise:
"Glory to the Great Maheshvara, the One beyond all causes!"7

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু দেখিয়া মুরারি ॥ ৬৪ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu biśbambhara hari |
kahite lāgilā kichu dekhiẏā murāri || 64 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; vishvambhara hari — Vishvambhara Hari; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say something; dekhiya murari — seeing Murari

64Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara Hari,
seeing Murari, began to speak:

শুন শুন অহে বৈদ্য আমার বচন ।
এড় গীতা-অধ্যাত্ম-চরচা তোর মন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

śuna śuna ahe baidya āmāra bacana |
eṛa gītā-adhyātma-caracā tora mana || 65 ||

shuna shuna ahe vaidya — hear, hear, O vaidya; amara bachana — My word; eda — give up; gita-adhyatma-characha — the song, the speculation about the Self; tora mana — [that occupies] your mind

65"Hear, hear, vaidya, My word:
give up [your] song — the speculation about the Self that occupies your mind8.

জীবার বাসনা যদি থাকয়ে তোমার ।
কৃষ্ণপ্রেমানন্দে যদি সাধ থাকে আর ॥ ৬৬ ॥

jībāra bāsanā yadi thākaẏe tomāra |
kṛṣṇapremānande yadi sādha thāke āra || 66 ||

jivara basana — the desire to live; yadi thakaye tomara — if you have; krishna-premanande — for the bliss of love for Krishna; yadi sadha thake ara — if you also have the wish

66If you have the desire to live,
and if you still have the wish [to taste] the bliss of love for Krishna,

অধ্যাত্ম-চরচা তবে কর পরিত্যাগ ।
গুণসংকীর্তন কর কৃষ্ণে অনুরাগ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

adhyātma-caracā tabe kara parityāga |
guṇasaṃkīrtana kara kṛṣṇe anurāga || 67 ||

adhyatma-characha — speculation about the Self; tabe kara parityaga — then give up; guna-sankirtana kara — perform sankirtana of the qualities; krishne anuraga — with love for Krishna

67then give up speculation about the Self
and sing the sankirtana of His qualities with love for Krishna.

নটবরশেখর সুন্দর শ্যামতনু ।
ইন্দ্রনীলমণিকান্তি করে বর-বেণু ॥ ৬৮ ॥

naṭabaraśekhara sundara śyāmatanu |
indranīlamaṇikānti kare bara-beṇu || 68 ||

natavara-shekhara — the crown of the best of dancers; sundara shyama-tanu — beautiful, dark of body; indranila-mani-kanti — with the lustre of a sapphire; kare bara-benu — a choice flute in His hand

68The crown of the best of dancers, beautiful, dark of body,
radiant as a sapphire, with a choice flute in His hand,

পীতাম্বরধর বনমালা যার গলে ।
সে প্রভুকে নাহি ভজ গোপীগণ-মেলে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

pītāmbaradhara banamālā yāra gale |
se prabhuke nāhi bhaja gopīgaṇa-mele || 69 ||

pitambara-dhara — wearing yellow garments; vanamala yara gale — with a forest garland on His neck; se prabhuke — that Lord; nahi bhaja — you do not worship; gopi-gana-mele — in the company of the gopis

69in yellow garments, with a forest garland on His neck —
yet that Lord, surrounded by the gopis, you do not worship!"

শুনিঞা মুরারি বৈদ্য প্রভু-আজ্ঞাবাণী ।
কাতর হইয়া কান্দে পড়িয়া ধরণী ॥ ৭০ ॥

śuniñā murāri baidya prabhu-ājñābāṇī |
kātara haiẏā kānde paṛiẏā dharaṇī || 70 ||

shunina — hearing; murari vaidya — Murari the vaidya; prabhu-ajna-vani — the Lord's commanding words; katara haiya kande — weeps in distress; padiya dharani — falling to the ground

70Hearing the Lord's commanding words, Murari the vaidya
fell to the ground in distress and weeps.

প্রভুর চরণে করে বিনয় বিস্তর ।
লঙ্ঘিবারে নারি প্রভু সংসার দুস্তর ॥ ৭১ ॥

prabhura caraṇe kare binaẏa bistara |
laṅghibāre nāri prabhu saṃsāra dustara || 71 ||

prabhura charane — at the Lord's feet; kare vinaya vistara — pleads humbly at length; langhibare nari — I cannot cross; prabhu — Lord; samsara dustara — the impassable samsara

71At the Lord's feet he humbly pleads at length:
"Lord, I cannot cross the impassable samsara.

ব্রহ্মা মহেশ্বর কিবা লখিমী অনন্ত ।
জিনিতে না পারে মায়া কেবল দুরন্ত ॥ ৭২ ॥

brahmā maheśbara kibā lakhimī ananta |
jinite nā pāre māẏā kebala duranta || 72 ||

brahma maheshvara — Brahma, Maheshvara; kiba lakhimi ananta — or Lakshmi, Ananta; jinite na pare maya — cannot conquer maya; kevala duranta — so invincible she is

72Neither Brahma nor Maheshvara, nor Lakshmi nor Ananta
can conquer maya — so invincible is she9.

পরম প্রবল মায়া কে জিনিতে পারে ।
তোমার প্রসাদ বিনা শুন বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

parama prabala māẏā ke jinite pāre |
tomāra prasāda binā śuna biśbambhare || 73 ||

parama prabala maya — the all-powerful maya; ke jinite pare — who can conquer; tomara prasada vina — without Your grace; shuna vishvambhare — hear, Vishvambhara

73Who can conquer the all-powerful maya
without Your grace? — hear, Vishvambhara.

আমি মহাধম কিবা শকতি আমার ।
সংসার জিনিঞা পদ ভজিতে তোমার ॥ ৭৪ ॥

āmi mahādhama kibā śakati āmāra |
saṃsāra jiniñā pada bhajite tomāra || 74 ||

ami mahadhama — I am the lowest of the low; kiba shakati amara — what power have I; samsara jinina — conquering samsara; pada bhajite tomara — to serve Your feet

74I am the lowest of the low; what power have I
to conquer samsara and serve Your feet?

দুঃখিত দেখিয়া যদি দয়া কর মোরে ।
করুণাবিগ্রহ প্রভু ভজোঁ মো তোমারে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

duḥkhita dekhiẏā yadi daẏā kara more |
karuṇābigraha prabhu bhajoṁ mo tomāre || 75 ||

duhkhita dekhiya — seeing me wretched; yadi daya kara more — if You show me mercy; karuna-vigraha prabhu — Lord, embodiment of compassion; bhajon mo tomare — I shall serve You

75If, seeing me wretched, You show me mercy,
[then], Lord, embodiment of compassion, I shall serve You.

এতকাল আছিল গুপত প্রেমধন ।
প্রকট করিলা প্রভু করুণা-কারণ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

etakāla āchila gupata premadhana |
prakaṭa karilā prabhu karuṇā-kāraṇa || 76 ||

etakala — for so long; achhila gupata — was hidden; premadhana — the treasure of prema; prakata karila prabhu — the Lord revealed; karuna-karana — out of compassion

76For so long the treasure of prema was hidden —
[and now] You, Lord, have revealed it out of compassion.

তোমার পদারবিন্দ-মকরন্দ-প্রেম ।
পিবউ আমার মন মধুকর যেন ॥ ৭৭ ॥

tomāra padārabinda-makaranda-prema |
pibau āmāra mana madhukara yena || 77 ||

tomara padaravinda-makaranda-prema — the nectar-prema of Your lotus feet; pibau — may drink; amara mana — my mind; madhukara yena — like a bee

77Let my mind, like a bee,
drink the nectar-prema of Your lotus feet.

এই বর দেহ মোরে করুণাসাগর ।
ঘৃণা না করিহ মোরে মো অতি পামর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

ei bara deha more karuṇāsāgara |
ghṛṇā nā kariha more mo ati pāmara || 78 ||

ei bara deha more — give me this boon; karuna-sagara — ocean of compassion; ghrina na kariha more — do not despise me; mo ati pamara — I am most wretched

78Give me this boon, ocean of compassion;
do not despise me — I am most wretched."

ঐছন কাতরবাণী শুনিঞা ঠাকুর ।
করুণা বাড়িল হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

aichana kātarabāṇī śuniñā ṭhākura |
karuṇā bāṛila hiẏā ānanda pracura || 79 ||

aichhana katara-vani — such humble words; shunina thakura — hearing, the Thakura; karuna badila hiya — compassion grew in His heart; ananda prachura — abundant joy

79Hearing such humble words, the Thakura
was filled with compassion and great joy.

হাসিয়া কহিল প্রভু শুনহ মুরারি ।
অচিরে অভীষ্ট সিদ্ধ হইবে তোহারি ॥ ৮০ ॥

hāsiẏā kahila prabhu śunaha murāri |
acire abhīṣṭa siddha haibe tohāri || 80 ||

hasiya kahila prabhu — smiling, the Lord said; shunaha murari — hear, Murari; achire — soon; abhishta siddha haibe tohari — your desire will be fulfilled

80Smiling, the Lord said: "Hear, Murari:
soon your desire will be fulfilled"10.

তবে সেই শ্রীনিবাস পণ্ডিত ঠাকুর ।
অতি মহাশুদ্ধমতি ভক্ত সুচতুর ॥ ৮১ ॥

tabe sei śrīnibāsa paṇḍita ṭhākura |
ati mahāśuddhamati bhakta sucatura || 81 ||

tabe sei — and then; shrinibasa pandita thakura — Srinivasa Pandita Thakura; ati maha-shuddha-mati — of the purest mind; bhakta su-chatura — a very wise devotee

81And Srinivasa Pandita Thakura
is a devotee of the purest mind and very wise.

কৃষ্ণসেবা করে নিতি লঞা ভ্রাতৃগণ ।
সর্বভাবে ভজে বিশ্বম্ভরের চরণ ॥ ৮২ ॥

kṛṣṇasebā kare niti lañā bhrātṛgaṇa |
sarbabhābe bhaje biśbambharera caraṇa || 82 ||

krishna-seva kare niti — daily serves Krishna; lana bhratri-gana — with his brothers; sarva-bhave — with all his heart; bhaje vishvambharera charana — worships Vishvambhara's feet

82Every day he serves Krishna together with his brothers;
with all his heart he worships Vishvambhara's feet.

নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন করে নিতি-নিতি ।
অনুজ রামের সনে বড়ই পীরিতি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana kare niti-niti |
anuja rāmera sane baṛai pīriti || 83 ||

nama-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of names and qualities; kare niti-niti — performs every day; anuja ramera sane — with his younger brother Rama; badai piriti — great love

83Every day he performs sankirtana of names and qualities;
with his younger brother Rama he has great love.

জ্যেষ্ঠসেবা-পরায়ণ শ্রীরাম পণ্ডিত ।
দুই ভাই মিলি' গায় হরিগুণগীত ॥ ৮৪ ॥

jyeṣṭhasebā-parāẏaṇa śrīrāma paṇḍita |
dui bhāi mili' gāẏa hariguṇagīta || 84 ||

jyeshtha-seva-parayana — devoted to serving his elder brother; shrirama pandita — Sri Rama Pandita; dui bhai mili — the two brothers together; gaya hari-guna-gita — sing songs of Hari's qualities

84Sri Rama Pandita is devoted to serving his elder brother;
the two brothers together sing songs of Hari's qualities.

শ্রীবাস শ্রীরাম প্রভুর প্রিয় দুইজন ।
তার সনে ক্রীড়া করে আনন্দিত মন ॥ ৮৫ ॥

śrībāsa śrīrāma prabhura priẏa duijana |
tāra sane krīṛā kare ānandita mana || 85 ||

shrivasa shrirama — Srivasa and Sri Rama; prabhura priya dui-jana — two dear ones of the Lord; tara sane krida kare — with them He plays; anandita mana — with a joyful heart

85Srivasa and Sri Rama are two favourites of the Lord;
with them He plays with a joyful heart.

তার ঘরে নাচে প্রভু তা-সভার সনে ।
কপিল ঠাকুর যেন বেড়ি' ঋষিগণে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

tāra ghare nāce prabhu tā-sabhāra sane |
kapila ṭhākura yena beṛi' ṛṣigaṇe || 86 ||

tara ghare — in their house; nache prabhu — the Lord dances; ta-sabhara sane — with them all; kapila thakura yena — like Kapila Thakura; bedi rishigane — surrounded by sages

86In their house the Lord dances with them all,
like Kapila Thakura in the circle of sages11.

হেনমতে আনন্দে কৌতুকে দিন যায় ।
শত শত শিষ্যগণ আপনে পড়ায় ॥ ৮৭ ॥

henamate ānande kautuke dina yāẏa |
śata śata śiṣyagaṇa āpane paṛāẏa || 87 ||

henamate — thus; anande kautuke — in joy and merriment; dina yaya — the days pass; shata shata shishya-gana — hundreds of students; apane padaya — He Himself teaches

87Thus in joy and merriment the days pass;
hundreds of students He Himself teaches.

শিষ্যে শিষ্যে মিলি' তারা করে অনুমান ।
আছিল তাহাতে এক বড় অগেয়ান ॥ ৮৮ ॥

śiṣye śiṣye mili' tārā kare anumāna |
āchila tāhāte eka baṛa ageẏāna || 88 ||

shishye shishye mili — student with student; tara kare anumana — they reason; achhila tahate — there was among them; eka bada ageyana — one great ignoramus

88The students reason among themselves;
among them was one great ignoramus.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ বলিয়ে যারে সেই মায়া এক ।
অবোধ ব্রাহ্মণ-পুত্র ইহা বলিলেক ॥ ৮৯ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇa baliẏe yāre sei māẏā eka |
abodha brāhmaṇa-putra ihā balileka || 89 ||

shrikrishna baliye yare — the one whom they call Sri Krishna; sei maya eka — is but maya; abodha brahmana-putra — the foolish son of a brahmana; iha balileka — said this

89"The one they call Sri Krishna is but maya" —
so said the foolish son of a brahmana.

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর দুই-কর দিল কাণে ।
তখনি চলিলা প্রভু সুরনদী-স্নানে ॥ ৯০ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura dui-kara dila kāṇe |
takhani calilā prabhu suranadī-snāne || 90 ||

shunina thakura — hearing, the Thakura; dui-kara dila kane — put both hands over His ears; takhani chalila prabhu — at once the Lord went; suranadi-snane — to bathe in the heavenly river

90Hearing this, the Thakura covered His ears with His hands
and at once went to bathe in the heavenly river.

সবসনে শিষ্যবর্গ-সনে গঙ্গাস্নান ।
সপুলক ঘন ঘন লয় হরিনাম ॥ ৯১ ॥

sabasane śiṣyabarga-sane gaṅgāsnāna |
sapulaka ghana ghana laẏa harināma || 91 ||

sabasane — in His clothes; shishya-varga-sane — with the students; ganga-snana — bathing in the Ganga; sapulaka — thrilling; ghana ghana laya hari-nama — repeats the name of Hari again and again

91In His clothes, together with the students, He bathes in the Ganga,
thrilling, repeating the name of Hari again and again:

পাপিষ্ঠ অধম ছার পাষণ্ড-চরিত্র ।
দুর্বচনে কর্ণ মোর কৈল অপবিত্র ॥ ৯২ ॥

pāpiṣṭha adhama chāra pāṣaṇḍa-caritra |
durbacane karṇa mora kaila apabitra || 92 ||

papishtha — sinful; adhama — low; chhara — wretched; pashanda-charitra — godless in character; durbachane — with evil words; karna mora kaila apavitra — has defiled My ears

92"Sinful, low, wretched, godless in character —
with his evil words he has defiled My ears!"12

ইহা বলি' ঘন ঘন লয় হরিনাম ।
কহয়ে লোচন গোরা সর্বগুণধাম ॥ ৯৩ ॥

ihā bali' ghana ghana laẏa harināma |
kahaẏe locana gorā sarbaguṇadhāma || 93 ||

iha bali — saying this; ghana ghana laya hari-nama — repeats the name of Hari again and again; kahaye lochana — Lochana says; gora sarva-guna-dhama — Gora is the abode of all virtues

93Saying this, He repeats the name of Hari again and again.
Lochana says: Gora is the abode of all virtues.

The Truth about Advaita

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day Sriman Mahaprabhu [with the devotees] came to the house of Sri Advaita Prabhu to see Him; Advaita Prabhu fell at the feet of Sriman Mahaprabhu. Mahaprabhu lovingly embraced Advaita Prabhu and in conversation glorified the pre-eminence of prema-bhakti in the age of Kali. Seeing a certain godless brahmana, Srivasa Pandita grew alarmed, and by the will of Sriman Mahaprabhu that brahmana was bewildered by maya. Then [the Lord], having enjoyed kirtana and a meal in Advaita's house, returned home. Afterwards Sriman Mahaprabhu, [having expounded the doctrine of the Self,] spoke of the greatness of supreme bhakti. Sri Advaita Acharya Prabhu came to Navadvipa and prostrated Himself fully at the feet of Sriman Mahaprabhu. At that time Sriman Mahaprabhu, in Srivasa's house, was worshipping His weapon, the club, in order to destroy the godless. Sriman Mahaprabhu, [greatly pleased] with Acharya Gosani, declared before the people, "Bhagavan descends by Advaita's desire," mounted a couch and ordered Advaita Prabhu to dance and sing kirtana. When Srivasa Pandita asked about the truth of Advaita, Sriman Mahaprabhu told the truth about Advaita and instructed everyone to serve Bhagavan13.

Raga bhatiyari; refrain: "Hari, Narayana, Gorachand, Shachi's darling — with the noose of prema He has bound the hearts of living beings!"

আর অপরূপ কথা কহিব এখন ।
সাবধানে শুন সভে ছাড়ি' আন মন ॥ ১ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā kahiba ekhana |
sābadhāne śuna sabhe chāṛi' āna mana || 1 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now; savadhane shuna sabhe — listen, all, attentively; chhadi ana mana — setting other thoughts aside

1Now I shall tell another wondrous story:
listen, all, attentively, setting other thoughts aside.

গোরাগুণ কহিতে পুলক বান্ধে গায় ।
অখণ্ড-পীযূষ গোরা-গুণের প্রভায় ॥ ২ ॥

gorāguṇa kahite pulaka bāndhe gāẏa |
akhaṇḍa-pīyūṣa gorā-guṇera prabhāẏa || 2 ||

gora-guna kahite — in telling Gora's qualities; pulaka bandhe gaya — the body is seized by thrill; akhanda-piyusha — of the unending nectar; gora-gunera prabhaya — by the power of Gora's qualities

2When one tells of Gora's qualities, the body thrills:
such is the power of the unending nectar of Gora's qualities.

শ্রীনিবাস-আদি করি শিষ্যবর্গ সঙ্গে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য দেখিবারে ভেল রঙ্গে ॥ ৩ ॥

śrīnibāsa-ādi kari śiṣyabarga saṅge |
adbaita-ācārya dekhibāre bhela raṅge || 3 ||

shrinibasa-adi kari — Srinivasa and others; shishya-varga sange — with the disciples; advaita-acharya dekhibare — to see Advaita Acharya; bhela range — He set out joyfully

3Together with Srinivasa and the other disciples
He set out joyfully to see Advaita Acharya14.

কেহো গীত গায় কেহো লয় হরিনাম ।
হরিহরি-বোল বোলে নাহিক উপাম ॥ ৪ ॥

keho gīta gāẏa keho laẏa harināma |
harihari-bola bole nāhika upāma || 4 ||

keho gita gaya — some sing songs; keho laya hari-nama — some repeat the name of Hari; hari-hari-bola bole — they cry "Hari, Hari!"; nahika upama — beyond compare

4Some sing songs, some repeat the name of Hari,
they cry "Hari, Hari!" — beyond compare.

আপনে ঠাকুর নাচে ভক্তগণ গায় ।
আপনা না জানে তারা প্রেমার প্রভায় ॥ ৫ ॥

āpane ṭhākura nāce bhaktagaṇa gāẏa |
āpanā nā jāne tārā premāra prabhāẏa || 5 ||

apane thakura nache — the Thakura Himself dances; bhakta-gana gaya — the devotees sing; apana na jane tara — they do not know themselves; premara prabhaya — by the power of prema

5The Thakura Himself dances, the devotees sing;
by the power of prema they do not know themselves.

আপাদ-মস্তক পুলক রাঙা দুই আঁখি ।
টলমল করে অঙ্গ গোরা-মুখ দেখি' ॥ ৬ ॥

āpāda-mastaka pulaka rāṅā dui āṁkhi |
ṭalamala kare aṅga gorā-mukha dekhi' || 6 ||

apada-mastaka pulaka — thrill from foot to head; ranga dui ankhi — red eyes; talamala kare anga — the body sways; gora-mukha dekhi — seeing Gora's face

6From head to foot [all] thrill, their eyes are red;
gazing at Gora's face, they sway.

মালসাট মারে প্রভু হুহুঙ্কার নাদে ।
ভূমিতে লোটাঞা সব পারিষদ কান্দে ॥ ৭ ॥

mālasāṭa māre prabhu huhuṅkāra nāde |
bhūmite loṭāñā saba pāriṣada kānde || 7 ||

malasata mare prabhu — the Lord slaps His arms like a wrestler; huhunkara nade — with roars of "hum!"; bhumite lotana — rolling on the ground; saba parishada kande — all the associates weep

7The Lord slaps His arms like a wrestler and roars "hum!";
rolling on the ground, all the associates weep.

এইমতে আনন্দে চলিয়া যায় পথে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি দেখিবার চিতে ॥ ৮ ॥

eimate ānande caliẏā yāẏa pathe |
adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi dekhibāra cite || 8 ||

eimate — thus; anande chaliya yaya pathe — joyfully they go along the road; advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; dekhibara chite — longing to see

8Thus in joy they go along the road,
longing to see Advaita Acharya Gosani.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি দেখিলা ত গিয়া ।
দণ্ডপরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ৯ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi dekhilā ta giẏā |
daṇḍaparaṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā || 9 ||

advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; dekhila ta giya — having gone, He saw; danda-paranama kare — prostrates Himself; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

9Arriving, He saw Advaita Acharya Gosani
and, falling to the ground, prostrated Himself.

সম্ভ্রমে আচার্য-গোসাঞি পড়িলা চরণে ।
বিস্তর বিনয় করে কাতর-বচনে ॥ ১০ ॥

sambhrame ācārya-gosāñi paṛilā caraṇe |
bistara binaẏa kare kātara-bacane || 10 ||

sambhrame — in dismay; acharya-gosani padila charane — Acharya Gosani fell at His feet; vistara vinaya kare — shows much humility; katara-bachane — with piteous words

10In dismay Acharya Gosani fell at His feet
and with much humility speaks piteously,

আমা হেন কোটি অদ্বৈতের শিরোমণি ।
প্রণতি করিয়া বোলে লোটাঞা ধরণী ॥ ১১ ॥

āmā hena koṭi adbaitera śiromaṇi |
praṇati kariẏā bole loṭāñā dharaṇī || 11 ||

ama hena — like me; koti advaitera — of millions of Advaitas; shiromani — the crown jewel; pranati kariya bole — bowing, He says; lotana dharani — rolling on the ground

11bowing and rolling on the ground:
"[You are] the crown of millions of Advaitas like me!"15

অন্যোন্যে দোঁহারে দোঁহে আলিঙ্গন করে ।
দোঁহারে সিঞ্চিল দোঁহে নয়নের জলে ॥ ১২ ॥

anyonye doṁhāre doṁhe āliṅgana kare |
doṁhāre siñcila doṁhe naẏanera jale || 12 ||

anyonye — mutually; donhare donhe — each the other; alingana kare — they embrace; donhare sinchila donhe — each sprinkled the other; nayanera jale — with the tears of the eyes

12They embrace each other
and bathe each other with the tears of their eyes.

আসনে বসিয়া প্রভু কহে নিজকথা ।
মনোহর পাপহর প্রেমভক্তিদাতা ॥ ১৩ ॥

āsane basiẏā prabhu kahe nijakathā |
manohara pāpahara premabhaktidātā || 13 ||

asane basiya — sitting on a seat; prabhu kahe nija-katha — the Lord speaks His words; manohara — captivating; papahara — removing sin; prema-bhakti-data — bestowing prema-bhakti

13Sitting down, the Lord speaks His words —
captivating, sin-removing, bestowing prema-bhakti.

শুনিয়া আচার্য-গোসাঞি বোলেন বচন ।
পাষণ্ডীকে গালি দিতে রাঙা দুলোচন ॥ ১৪ ॥

śuniẏā ācārya-gosāñi bolena bacana |
pāṣaṇḍīke gāli dite rāṅā dulocana || 14 ||

shuniya — having heard; acharya-gosani bolena bachana — Acharya Gosani speaks; pashandike gali dite — in rebuking the godless; ranga dulochana — His two eyes are red

14Having heard, Acharya Gosani speaks;
His eyes redden as He rebukes the godless:

পাষণ্ডী বোলয়ে কলিযুগে ভক্তি নাই ।
সে চক্ষে দেখুক মোর চৈতন্য-গোসাঞি ॥ ১৫ ॥

pāṣaṇḍī bolaẏe kaliyuge bhakti nāi |
se cakṣe dekhuka mora caitanya-gosāñi || 15 ||

pashandi bolaye — the godless say; kali-yuge bhakti nai — there is no bhakti in the Kali-yuga; se chakshe dekhuka — let them see with their eyes; mora chaitanya-gosani — my Chaitanya Gosani

15"The godless say, 'In the Kali-yuga there is no bhakti' —
let them see with their own eyes my Chaitanya Gosani!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু স্ফুরিত-অধর ।
কহিতে লাগিলা মেঘগম্ভীর উত্তর ॥ ১৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu sphurita-adhara |
kahite lāgilā meghagambhīra uttara || 16 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhu sphurita-adhara — the Lord, His lips trembling; kahite lagila — began to speak; megha-gambhira uttara — a reply deep as thunder

16Hearing these words, the Lord, His lips trembling,
began to reply in a voice deep as thunder:

ভক্তি নাহি কলিযুগে আছে আর কি ।
ভক্তিমাত্র আছে তেঞি সংসারেতে জী ॥ ১৭ ॥

bhakti nāhi kaliyuge āche āra ki |
bhaktimātra āche teñi saṃsārete jī || 17 ||

bhakti nahi kali-yuge — no bhakti in the Kali-yuga; achhe ara ki — what else is there; bhakti-matra achhe — there is bhakti alone; teni samsarete ji — by it the world lives

17"'There is no bhakti in the Kali-yuga' — what else is there, then?
There is bhakti alone — by it the world lives.

কলিযুগে ভক্তি নাহি যে বোলে বচন ।
নিরর্থক জন্ম তার শুন সর্বজন ॥ ১৮ ॥

kaliyuge bhakti nāhi ye bole bacana |
nirarthaka janma tāra śuna sarbajana || 18 ||

kali-yuge bhakti nahi — "no bhakti in the Kali-yuga"; ye bole bachana — whoever says these words; nirarthaka janma tara — his birth is in vain; shuna sarvajana — hear, all

18One who says, 'There is no bhakti in the Kali-yuga' —
his birth is in vain; hear, all of you.

কলিযুগে কৃষ্ণভক্তি পরসন্ন মায়া ।
কলিযুগ হেন কোন যুগে নাহি দয়া ॥ ১৯ ॥

kaliyuge kṛṣṇabhakti parasanna māẏā |
kaliyuga hena kona yuge nāhi daẏā || 19 ||

kali-yuge krishna-bhakti — in the Kali-yuga devotion to Krishna; parasanna maya — gracious love (favour); kali-yuga hena — as in the Kali-yuga; kona yuge nahi daya — in no yuga is there such mercy

19In the Kali-yuga there is devotion to Krishna, [given] by [the Lord's] gracious love:
in no other yuga is there such mercy as in Kali"16.

হেনই সময়ে সে পণ্ডিত শ্রীবাস ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু অন্তরে তরাস ॥ ২০ ॥

henai samaẏe se paṇḍita śrībāsa |
kahite lāgilā kichu antare tarāsa || 20 ||

henai samaye — at this time; se pandita shrivasa — Pandita Srivasa; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say; antare tarasa — with fear in his heart

20At this time Pandita Srivasa,
with fear in his heart, began to speak:

সম্মুখে দেখহ প্রভু পাষণ্ডী ব্রাহ্মণ ।
কৃষ্ণমহোৎসবে বাধা দিবেক এখন ॥ ২১ ॥

sammukhe dekhaha prabhu pāṣaṇḍī brāhmaṇa |
kṛṣṇamahotsabe bādhā dibeka ekhana || 21 ||

sammukhe dekhaha — look in front; prabhu — Lord; pashandi brahmana — a godless brahmana; krishna-mahotsave — to Krishna's festival; badha dibeka ekhana — will now cause a hindrance

21"See, Lord, there in front — a godless brahmana:
now he will disrupt Krishna's festival.

এই মহাপাষণ্ড এ অতি দুরাচার ।
বিদ্যা-অভিমানে করে মহা-অহঙ্কার ॥ ২২ ॥

ei mahāpāṣaṇḍa e ati durācāra |
bidyā-abhimāne kare mahā-ahaṅkāra || 22 ||

ei maha-pashanda — this is a great godless man; e ati durachara — of very wicked conduct; vidya-abhimane — proud of learning; kare maha-ahankara — he is exceedingly arrogant

22He is a great godless man, of very wicked conduct;
proud of his learning, he is exceedingly arrogant."

তবে মহাপ্রভু কথা কহিল তাহারে ।
এথা না আসিব এই দুষ্ট দুরাচারে ॥ ২৩ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu kathā kahila tāhāre |
ethā nā āsiba ei duṣṭa durācāre || 23 ||

tabe mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; katha kahila tahare — said to him; etha na asiba — will not come here; ei dushta durachare — this wicked scoundrel

23Then Mahaprabhu said to him:
"This wicked scoundrel will not come here."

না আইল ব্রাহ্মণ সেই মায়াবিমোহিত ।
ক্রীড়া করে মহাপ্রভু আনন্দিতচিত ॥ ২৪ ॥

nā āila brāhmaṇa sei māẏābimohita |
krīṛā kare mahāprabhu ānanditacita || 24 ||

na aila brahmana sei — that brahmana did not come; maya-vimohita — bewildered by maya; krida kare mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu plays; anandita-chita — with a joyful heart

24And the brahmana, bewildered by maya, did not come17,
while Mahaprabhu, joyful at heart, gives Himself to play:

শ্রীনিবাস-ভুজে এক ভুজ আরোপিয়া ।
গদাধর-কর ধরি' বাম-কর দিয়া ॥ ২৫ ॥

śrīnibāsa-bhuje eka bhuja āropiẏā |
gadādhara-kara dhari' bāma-kara diẏā || 25 ||

shrinibasa-bhuje — on Srinivasa's arm; eka bhuja aropiya — placing one arm; gadadhara-kara dhari — holding Gadadhara's hand; bama-kara diya — with His left hand

25placing one arm on Srinivasa's arm,
with His left hand He holds Gadadhara's hand;

নরহরি-অঙ্গে প্রভু শ্রীঅঙ্গ হেলিয়া ।
শ্রীরঘুনন্দন-মুখ কান্দয়ে হেরিয়া ॥ ২৬ ॥

narahari-aṅge prabhu śrīaṅga heliẏā |
śrīraghunandana-mukha kāndaẏe heriẏā || 26 ||

narahari-ange — against Narahari; prabhu shri-anga heliya — the Lord, leaning His body; shri-raghunandana-mukha — Sri Raghunandana's face; kandaye heriya — gazing, He weeps

26leaning His body on Narahari,
He gazes at Sri Raghunandana's face and weeps;

শ্রীরাম-পণ্ডিত-অঙ্গে দিয়া পাদাম্বুজ ।
ক্রীড়া করে মহাপ্রভু আচার্য-সম্মুখ ॥ ২৭ ॥

śrīrāma-paṇḍita-aṅge diẏā pādāmbuja |
krīṛā kare mahāprabhu ācārya-sammukha || 27 ||

shrirama-pandita-ange — on Sri Rama Pandita's body; diya padambuja — placing His lotus feet; krida kare mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu plays; acharya-sammukha — before the Acharya

27placing His lotus feet on Sri Rama Pandita,
Mahaprabhu plays before the Acharya.

চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণব করে গুণসংকীর্তন ।
মধ্যেতে নাচেন প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ॥ ২৮ ॥

caudige baiṣṇaba kare guṇasaṃkīrtana |
madhyete nācena prabhu śacīra nandana || 28 ||

chaudige — all around; vaishnava kare guna-sankirtana — the Vaishnavas sing the sankirtana of qualities; madhyete nachena prabhu — in the middle dances the Lord; shachira nandana — the son of Shachi

28All around the Vaishnavas sing the sankirtana of His qualities,
and in the middle dances the Lord, the son of Shachi,

যেন রাসমহোৎসবে বেড়ি' গোপীগণ ।
কীর্তনের মাঝে এইমত সুশোভন ॥ ২৯ ॥

yena rāsamahotsabe beṛi' gopīgaṇa |
kīrtanera mājhe eimata suśobhana || 29 ||

yena rasa-mahotsave — as at the festival of the rasa; bedi gopi-gana — surrounded by the gopis; kirtanera majhe — in the midst of the kirtana; eimata sushobhana — so beautiful

29as at the festival of the rasa, surrounded by the gopis —
so beautiful was [His play] in the midst of the kirtana.

এইমতে কথোক্ষণে নৃত্য-অবসানে ।
হরষিত অদ্বৈত-আচার্য সীতা-সনে ॥ ৩০ ॥

eimate kathokṣaṇe nṛtya-abasāne |
haraṣita adbaita-ācārya sītā-sane || 30 ||

eimate — thus; kathokshane — after a while; nritya-avasane — at the end of the dance; harashita advaita-acharya — the delighted Advaita Acharya; sita-sane — together with Sita

30Thus after a while, when the dance was over,
Advaita Acharya, together with Sita, rejoiced.

তবে তার ঘরে প্রভু ভোজন করিল ।
সুগন্ধি চন্দন মালা শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেপিল ॥ ৩১ ॥

tabe tāra ghare prabhu bhojana karila |
sugandhi candana mālā śrīaṅge lepila || 31 ||

tabe tara ghare — then in His house; prabhu bhojana karila — the Lord ate; sugandhi chandana mala — fragrant sandal, a garland; shri-ange lepila — were applied to His body

31Then in His house the Lord took His meal;
His body was anointed with fragrant sandal paste and adorned with a garland.

Notes

  1. "Illusory" (michha) in the sense of transient and deceptive: the world is created by the Lord's energy and is real, but it is false to regard it as one's own and to seek happiness in it (v. 39). Cf. Murari 2.4.6–11, where the same miracle with the tree is called "a conjurer's trick".
  2. Cf. Bhagavad-gita 7.14: the Lord's maya is hard to overcome, but those who surrender to Him overcome it. Here maya is the Lord's external energy, which He controls.
  3. Not merging with Krishna: one who has given everything to Krishna has no interests left apart from His will (cf. Bhagavata 7.5.23 on atma-nivedana, and 11.29.34).
  4. Cf. Murari 2.4.10–11: everything done for the Master bears fruit.
  5. A verse of the Padma-purana; it is quoted by Murari (2.4.14) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9.29). The Lord jokingly "praises" Mukunda for his knowledge of Brahman and shows that the Supreme Brahman is Rama Himself, a Person.
  6. So also in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: Krishna is the original Personality of Godhead Himself ("krishnas tu bhagavan svayam", Bhagavata 1.3.28), and Narayana is His manifestation. Cf. Murari 2.4.15–17.
  7. Cf. Murari 2.4.18–21.
  8. Lit. "give up the gita (song)…". In Murari (2.4.22–23) the Lord reproaches Murari for his song on the doctrine of the Self and tells him to compose a shloka about Hari. The vaidya is Murari Gupta, who like Mukunda was of the vaidya community.
  9. Murari's humble exaggeration: in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology Lakshmi is the Lord's internal energy and Ananta His expansion, and maya has no power over them. The point is that no one can conquer maya by his own strength (cf. Gita 7.14).
  10. Cf. Murari 2.4.22–27; there the Lord's blessing is understood as permission for Murari to tell of His descent.
  11. Cf. Murari 2.4.27–32. Kapila is the sage, a descent of Vishnu, teacher of sankhya.
  12. Cf. Murari 2.4.33–34. The words "Krishna is maya" express the Mayavada view, in which Krishna's form is a product of maya; for Vaishnavas this is the gravest offence: Krishna's form is eternal and spiritual (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 17.129–133).
  13. The summary covers the whole section; this portion contains vv. 1–35 (the Lord at Advaita's), the rest is in the next portion. Some places in the summary are illegible in the OCR of the edition and are restored by sense (in square brackets).
  14. Cf. Murari 2.5.1–19: the Lord goes to Advaita in Shantipur.
  15. Cf. Murari 2.5.3–5: the Lord first prostrates Himself before Advaita, "honouring the Vaishnava as Vishnu Himself", and Advaita in dismay falls at His feet. In Gaudiya Vaishnava theology Advaita is Maha-Vishnu and the Lord's eternal servant; His humility is an example for devotees.
  16. "Gracious love" — in the original "prasanna maya": the Bengali word maya is used here in its ordinary sense of "tenderness, love, compassion", not illusion. Cf. Murari 2.5.7–10.
  17. Cf. Murari 2.5.11–13: "blinded by the maya of Vishnu". Maya here is the Lord's external energy, which by His will keeps non-devotees away from the kirtana.
